title: The Lancashire Creamery Pistachio & Hazelnut Custard 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pistachio and Hazelnut Custard by Lancashire Creamery is a decadent dessert blend that brings together rich, roasted Nut notes with silky-smooth Vanilla Custard. The Pistachio delivers a mellow, nutty warmth, while the Hazelnut adds deeper, toasted character to the base. These earthy tones are lifted by the soft sweetness of creamy Custard, creating a luxurious and well-rounded flavour profile that lingers on the tastebuds. This nicotine salt e-liquid provides a smooth, tactile throat hit with fast-absorbing nicotine. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with refillable pod vape kits , vape pens , and starter vape kits . Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths to suit a wide range of vapers. Lancashire Creamery e-liquids are proudly made in the UK and inspired by indulgent dessert traditions, offering premium-quality flavours for vapers with a taste for the rich and satisfying.
